passages.heading: Debt note
passages.text: 12. CONVERTIBLE DEBT Convertible notes issued in September 2025 On September 15, 2025, the Group completed a private placement, pursuant to Rule 144A under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, of $ 2.75 billion aggregate original principal amount of senior unsecured convertible notes (the “September 2025 Notes”) to qualified institutional buyers, which are convertible at their option. The September 2025 Notes were issued in two equal series: ● $ 1.375 billion 1.00 % Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 (the “2030 Notes”), and ● $ 1.375 billion 2.75 % Convertible Senior Notes due 2032 (the “2032 Notes”). The September 2025 Notes are convertible at the option of the holders into the Company’s Class A ordinary shares at an initial conversion rate of 7.2072 shares per $1,000 principal amount (approximately $ 138.75 per share), subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments. Upon conversion, the Notes are settled entirely in shares. Prior to maturity, the Notes are convertible only upon the occurrence of specified conditions, including: • If the Company’s share price exceeds 130 % of the applicable conversion price for a specified period; • In connection with certain corporate events, including a fundamental change; • During the two months preceding maturity; or • Following the issuance of a redemption notice by the Company. If a holder converts its Notes in connection with a make-whole fundamental change (generally including certain change-in-control transactions, delisting events, or other specified corporate transactions), the conversion rate will be increased by an additional number of shares as determined pursuant to a schedule set forth in the indenture. The Company may redeem the Notes, in whole or in part, on or after September 20, 2028, if the share price exceeds 130 % of the applicable conversion price for a specified period, at a redemption price equal to 100 % of the accreted principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Upon the occurrence of a fundamental change, holders may require the Company to repurchase their Notes at a price equal to 100 % of the accreted principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. The September 2025 Notes were issued at par, but accrete to a higher accreted principal amount over time: • The 2030 Notes accrete to 115 % of their original principal at maturity (i.e. $ 1,150 for every $1,000 issued), and • The 2032 Notes accrete to 115 % of their original principal at maturity (i.e. $ 1,150 for every $1,000 issued). The Group also granted the initial purchasers a 13-day over-allotment option (greenshoe) to purchase up to an additional $ 412.5 aggregate original principal amount of September 2025 Notes ( 15 % of the base size), split equally between the two series. This option was fully exercised on or before September 28, 2025, increasing the total original aggregate principal amount issued to approximately $ 3.2 billion. The accreted principal amount is payable only upon maturity or early redemption. The 2030 Notes and 2032 Notes bear interest at 1.00 % and 2.75 %, respectively, payable semi-annually in arrears on March 15 and September 15 of each year, beginning March 15, 2026. You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report. In addition to historical information, this discussion contains forward-looking statements based on our current expectations that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth in the “Risk Factors” and “Forward Looking Statements” sections and elsewhere in this Annual Report. The historical results described below relate to the results of our continuing operations. Overview Nebius, a global AI cloud platform, delivers a unified full-stack AI cloud that spans the complete AI journey – from compute capacity to software and services – that enable fast and efficient training and inference at scale. Founded around deep in-house technological expertise, Nebius offers a comprehensive and integrated suite of AI and ML cloud solutions, including both hardware and software built in-house. This combination of AI-optimized hardware and software enables us to deliver high-performance GPU compute clusters, storage, managed services, and advanced tools for AI model training and inference at enterprise-scale. Headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on Nasdaq, Nebius Group offers one of the few global, at scale, multi-tenant clouds purpose built for AI, with a significant presence in Europe, the U.S., and other geographies around the world. Nebius Group includes Nebius as well as two distinct businesses that operate under separate brands: Avride, a leading developer of autonomous vehicles and delivery robots; and TripleTen, a leading edtech platform focused on reskilling people for careers in tech. Nebius Group also owns significant equity stakes in ClickHouse and Toloka, both of which have been spun out of the group. We believe the most significant factors that affect our businesses are the following: ● Competing effectively in a rapidly evolving market. We operate in a highly competitive industry characterized by continuous technological advancements and evolving customer needs. To strengthen our market position, we are investing in the continuing development of a flexible, full-stack AI cloud solution that extends beyond bare-metal compute, and includes comprehensive software and value-added services for our clients. This approach positions us well to address a broader customer base - ranging from start-ups to independent software vendors and enterprises - and drive long-term growth. 44 Table of Contents ● Expanding our customer base. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow covers debt service comfortably, with cash from operations exceeding gross interest expense by a wide margin. The company's cash flow to debt ratio sits well above the sector median, indicating strong internal liquidity generation relative to peers. This robust cash generation provides a solid buffer for fixed charges and supports the current minimal financial risk profile.

The company maintains a substantial cash position that exceeds its reported debt, resulting in negative net debt on a cash-only basis. This net cash position, combined with a leverage ratio below the sector median, underscores a conservative balance sheet. Such liquidity reduces refinancing risk and provides flexibility for growth investments.

key_risks.text: The company faces intense competition in the rapidly evolving AI cloud market, requiring continuous investment in technology and customer acquisition. This competitive pressure could erode margins and cash flow if the company fails to keep pace with larger incumbents. The risk is compounded by the capital-intensive nature of the business, which demands ongoing funding.

The recent issuance of convertible notes due in the early next decade introduces potential dilution and refinancing risk. These notes accrete to a higher principal amount at maturity, increasing the effective repayment burden. While conversion features may mitigate cash settlement, a falling share price could force share settlement or require refinancing under adverse conditions.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is adequate but below the sector median, with operating income covering interest expense only about two and a half times. This relatively thin cushion leaves limited headroom for earnings volatility. However, the company's substantial cash balance and positive operating cash flow provide additional capacity to meet interest obligations.

Free cash flow is negative due to heavy capital expenditures, which absorb more than operating cash flow. This cash burn necessitates external funding or cash reserves to sustain operations. While the company has ample liquidity, persistent negative free cash flow could strain financial flexibility if not reversed through improved profitability or reduced investment.

overall_credit_view.text: The company's minimal financial risk profile is supported by low leverage, substantial cash, and strong operating cash flow. However, negative free cash flow and below-median interest coverage warrant monitoring. The competitive AI cloud landscape and recent convertible debt issuance add complexity. Overall, credit fundamentals are sound but require ongoing vigilance regarding cash burn and market dynamics.

Analyst judgement: the company is well-positioned to manage its debt obligations given its net cash position and cash generation. However, the capital-intensive nature of its operations and the need to invest in growth may keep free cash flow negative in the near term. The convertible notes due in the next decade provide long-dated funding but introduce potential dilution. Continued access to capital markets or cash reserves will be key.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋債務償付，營運所得現金大幅超過總利息支出。公司的現金流對債務比率遠高於行業中位數，顯示其內部流動性生成能力相對於同業強勁。這種強勁的現金生成為固定費用提供了穩固的緩衝，並支持當前極低的財務風險狀況。
公司持有大量現金，超過其報告債務，導致僅按現金計算的淨債務為負。這種淨現金狀況，加上低於行業中位數的槓桿比率，凸顯了保守的資產負債表。此類流動性降低了再融資風險，並為增長投資提供了靈活性。

key_risks.text: 公司在快速演變的AI雲端市場面臨激烈競爭，需要持續投資於技術和客戶獲取。如果公司未能跟上大型現有企業的步伐，這種競爭壓力可能侵蝕利潤率和現金流。該風險因業務的資本密集型性質而加劇，需要持續的資金投入。
近期發行的可轉換票據將於下個十年初期到期，引入了潛在的稀釋和再融資風險。這些票據在到期時累積至更高的本金金額，增加了實際還款負擔。雖然轉換特性可能減輕現金結算，但股價下跌可能迫使股份結算或在不利條件下進行再融資。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率充足但低於行業中位數，營運收入僅覆蓋利息支出約兩倍半。這一相對薄弱的緩衝為盈利波動留下了有限空間。然而，公司大量的現金餘額和正營運現金流提供了額外的能力來滿足利息義務。
由於大量資本支出吸收了超過營運現金流的資金，自由現金流為負。這種現金消耗需要外部融資或現金儲備來維持運營。雖然公司擁有充足的流動性，但持續的負自由現金流如果未能通過改善盈利能力或減少投資來扭轉，可能會削弱財務靈活性。

overall_credit_view.text: 公司極低的財務風險狀況得到低槓桿、大量現金和強勁營運現金流的支持。然而，負自由現金流和低於中位數的利息覆蓋率需要監控。競爭激烈的AI雲端環境和近期發行的可轉換債務增加了複雜性。總體而言，信用基本面穩健，但需要持續關注現金消耗和市場動態。
分析師判斷：鑑於其淨現金狀況和現金生成能力，公司有能力管理其債務義務。然而，其運營的資本密集型性質和增長投資需求可能使自由現金流在短期內保持負值。下個十年到期的可轉換票據提供了長期資金，但引入了潛在稀釋。持續進入資本市場或現金儲備將是關鍵。
